scientific_plan.purpose: Determine whether raw semantic teacher 17315 still emits gross or highly suspicious poker actions on fresh 3H scenarios.

interpretation_rule.critical: Any AA preflop fold or full-house-plus postflop fold is a gross-error candidate and requires exact trace review.
interpretation_rule.high_review: Any deep 72o jam or trips-plus fold requires exact trace review; the heuristic flag alone is not a poker-theory verdict.
interpretation_rule.review: Top-pair folds and deep high-card jams are context-sensitive review surfaces, not automatic errors.
interpretation_rule.no_flag: Absence of flags on this finite fresh sample supports sanity on these surfaces only; it does not prove globally sound poker.

exclusions: no replacement of post15315 multi-rebuild stabilization
no canonical DeepCrusher strength claim before DC0

policy_surface_analysis.purpose: Measure target-action probability on every eligible sanity opportunity independent of sampled action RNG.
